action.objective: Verify e1e2 as the reserved candidate at full depth before committing; it leads the broad search and keeps the king off the h2 queen's diagonal.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 found e1e2 best (-854 exact) but only 3000 nodes were used, so no candidate is verified. e1e2 is the reserved suggestion with a 2000-node allowance; verifying it preserves the strongest evidence. Alternative g2g4 (-855) is an upper bound only.
